name: The Fool
meaning_upright: Starting fresh, taking a leap of faith, trusting the journey, embracing the unknown with excitement.
meaning_reversed: Acting recklessly, ignoring red flags, being naive, holding yourself back out of fear.

name: The Magician
meaning_upright: You have everything you need. Use your skills, speak up, and make things happen.
meaning_reversed: Feeling out of your depth, second-guessing yourself, or someone is not being straight with you.

name: The High Priestess
meaning_upright: Trust your gut. There is more going on beneath the surface — be patient and listen within.
meaning_reversed: Ignoring your intuition, secrets being kept, or disconnecting from what you truly know.

name: The Empress
meaning_upright: Abundance, creativity, nurturing energy. Take care of yourself and others. Invest in what grows.
meaning_reversed: Burnout from giving too much, creative blocks, neglecting self-care or personal needs.

name: The Emperor
meaning_upright: Structure, authority, and stability. Set boundaries, take charge, and build a solid foundation.
meaning_reversed: Too rigid, domineering, losing control, or lacking structure in an important area of life.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_upright: Following an established path, seeking guidance or mentorship, honoring tradition and community.
meaning_reversed: Breaking from tradition, questioning authority, going your own way instead of the expected route.

name: The Lovers
meaning_upright: A meaningful choice, alignment of values, deep connection, and relationships built on honesty.
meaning_reversed: Conflict in a relationship, misaligned values, avoiding a difficult decision, or a messy split.

name: The Chariot
meaning_upright: Forward momentum — you are driven, focused, and on your way to winning. Stay in the driver's seat.
meaning_reversed: Losing direction, forcing outcomes, or letting competing priorities pull you off course.

name: Strength
meaning_upright: Inner strength, courage, and calm confidence. Handle things with grace, not force.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt, fear taking over, or using aggression instead of calm resilience.

name: The Hermit
meaning_upright: Time alone to reflect, soul-search, and find your own answers. Wisdom comes from within.
meaning_reversed: Isolation that is harming you, refusing help, or being so withdrawn you are missing connections.

name: Wheel of Fortune
meaning_upright: Things are shifting — in your favor. Cycles turning, timing clicking, luck and momentum building.
meaning_reversed: Bad timing, things spinning out of control, or resisting an inevitable change in your situation.

name: Justice
meaning_upright: Accountability, fairness, and balance. What is done comes back around. Decisions made with clarity.
meaning_reversed: Unfair outcomes, avoiding responsibility, or a situation lacking honesty and proper accountability.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: Pause, surrender, shift your perspective. The delay is the lesson. Let things unfold in their time.
meaning_reversed: Stalling because you are scared, martyrdom, or refusing to see things from another angle.

name: Death
meaning_upright: A chapter is ending so something better can begin. Let go — transformation is happening right now.
meaning_reversed: Resisting change, clinging to what has already ended, or fear of moving on and starting over.

name: Temperance
meaning_upright: Balance, patience, moderation. Take the middle road. Flow between extremes and find your equilibrium.
meaning_reversed: Excess, imbalance, rushing a process that needs time, or extremes pulling you off center.

name: The Devil
meaning_upright: Patterns and habits that hold you back. Facing what keeps you stuck is the first step to freedom.
meaning_reversed: Breaking free from a toxic cycle, reclaiming your power, or finally stepping out of a shadow.

name: The Tower
meaning_upright: A sudden shakeup, revelation, or breakdown of something that was not built to last. Honesty arrives hard.
meaning_reversed: Avoiding necessary disruption, fearing change that would actually help, or delaying an inevitable collapse.

name: The Star
meaning_upright: Hope, healing, and calm after a storm. You are being guided and supported. Trust the path forward.
meaning_reversed: Loss of hope, despair, or disconnecting from the belief that things will actually get better.

name: The Moon
meaning_upright: Something is unclear — do not rush. Intuition is high but illusions are too. Navigate the fog carefully.
meaning_reversed: Confusion lifting, hidden things coming to light, or anxiety easing as clarity finally arrives.

name: The Sun
meaning_upright: Joy, confidence, success, and clarity. Things are going great and you deserve to enjoy every bit of it.
meaning_reversed: Temporary setbacks blocking your joy, or struggling to feel good even when things are actually going well.

name: Judgement
meaning_upright: A major call to action, self-evaluation, and rising to your next level. You are ready for what is next.
meaning_reversed: Self-doubt holding you back, fear of being judged, ignoring the call to evolve and step up.

name: The World
meaning_upright: Completion, achievement, and fulfillment. A major cycle closes successfully — celebrate and integrate the win.
meaning_reversed: Unfinished business, rushing to the next thing before honoring this completion, or feeling stuck at the finish line.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_upright: A spark of inspiration hitting. New creative energy, a bold idea, or the drive to start something exciting.
meaning_reversed: Creative block, false starts, or that big idea not quite taking off the way you hoped.

name: 2 of Wands
meaning_upright: You are planning your next move. Ambition and vision are strong — step outside your comfort zone.
meaning_reversed: Overthinking your options, fear of commitment, or playing it too safe when you should be moving.

name: 3 of Wands
meaning_upright: Expansion is underway. You launched something and now you wait for returns — keep your vision wide.
meaning_reversed: Setbacks in plans, delays in results, or unexpected obstacles slowing down your progress.

name: 4 of Wands
meaning_upright: Celebration, stability, and milestones worth marking. Gather the people you love and enjoy the moment.
meaning_reversed: Disruption in a happy environment, family tension, or a celebration that feels incomplete or off.

name: 5 of Wands
meaning_upright: Competing ideas, friction, and a bit of chaos. Navigate conflict productively — this energy can spark growth.
meaning_reversed: Avoiding conflict that needs addressing, or internal struggle between your own competing desires.

name: 6 of Wands
meaning_upright: Victory and recognition — your effort is paying off and people see it. Own this win confidently.
meaning_reversed: Success going unrecognized, setbacks to your reputation, or ego getting in the way of real achievement.

name: 7 of Wands
meaning_upright: Hold your ground. You are in a competitive spot but you have the advantage — do not back down.
meaning_reversed: Caving to pressure, abandoning your position, or overwhelming opposition making you doubt yourself.

name: 8 of Wands
meaning_upright: Everything is moving fast — messages, travel, momentum. Quick action is needed and things are taking off.
meaning_reversed: Delays and miscommunication, plans hitting a wall, or energy scattered in too many directions.

name: 9 of Wands
meaning_upright: You are tired but almost there. Stay resilient — one more push and you will cross the finish line.
meaning_reversed: Burnout, paranoia, or refusing to keep going when you actually have more capacity than you think.

name: 10 of Wands
meaning_upright: Carrying too much. You may need to delegate, set boundaries, or drop something that is weighing you down.
meaning_reversed: Finally releasing a burden, or being crushed under responsibilities you refuse to let go of.

name: Page of Wands
meaning_upright: Enthusiastic new energy, a curious beginner spirit, fresh creative ideas, and bold first moves.
meaning_reversed: Immaturity, half-baked ideas, or lots of enthusiasm with no follow-through.

name: Knight of Wands
meaning_upright: Fast-moving, passionate, adventurous. Acting on impulse and chasing goals with full energy.
meaning_reversed: Reckless, impulsive, scattered energy, or burning out before the goal is reached.

name: Queen of Wands
meaning_upright: Confident, magnetic, and creative. She knows her worth and leads with energy and warmth.
meaning_reversed: Insecurity masked as arrogance, jealousy, or dimming your light because of what others might think.

name: King of Wands
meaning_upright: Visionary leadership, bold action, and charismatic authority. Lead with purpose and inspire others.
meaning_reversed: Domineering, impatient, or using your influence in ways that harm rather than help.

name: Ace of Cups
meaning_upright: New emotional beginnings — a new love, a creative burst, compassion, and emotional openness.
meaning_reversed: Emotional walls, blocked feelings, or an opportunity for connection that you are not ready to receive.

name: 2 of Cups
meaning_upright: Mutual connection, partnership, and attraction. Two people on the same page — romantic or otherwise.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance in a relationship, one-sided feelings, or a connection falling apart.

name: 3 of Cups
meaning_upright: Friendship, celebration, and community joy. A time to gather, laugh, and appreciate your people.
meaning_reversed: Gossip, overindulgence, or feeling left out of a group you want to be part of.

name: 4 of Cups
meaning_upright: Feeling bored, withdrawn, or unmotivated. Something is being offered — are you open enough to see it?
meaning_reversed: Snapping out of apathy, accepting an opportunity, or finally reconnecting with what matters to you.

name: 5 of Cups
meaning_upright: Grief, disappointment, or loss. It is okay to mourn — but do not forget what is still standing behind you.
meaning_reversed: Moving through grief, accepting loss, and beginning to shift focus toward healing and what remains.

name: 6 of Cups
meaning_upright: Nostalgia, childhood memories, or reconnecting with someone or something from your past.
meaning_reversed: Living too much in the past, being unable to move forward, or an unhealthy attachment to how things were.

name: 7 of Cups
meaning_upright: Too many options and daydreams clouding your judgment. Get grounded and make a real decision.
meaning_reversed: Cutting through illusion, getting clear on priorities, or finally choosing a direction.

name: 8 of Cups
meaning_upright: Walking away from something that no longer serves you — even if it is hard. Emotional evolution.
meaning_reversed: Staying in something out of fear, avoiding the necessary goodbye, or returning to what you left.

name: 9 of Cups
meaning_upright: Your wish is coming true. Emotional satisfaction, contentment, and getting exactly what you wanted.
meaning_reversed: Overindulgence, complacency, or realizing the thing you wanted does not actually make you happy.

name: 10 of Cups
meaning_upright: Emotional fulfillment, family harmony, and lasting happiness. This is the good life — enjoy it.
meaning_reversed: Disconnection from loved ones, family conflict, or a picture-perfect life masking real struggles.

name: Page of Cups
meaning_upright: Creative, intuitive, and emotionally curious. Good news or a gentle, imaginative invitation to open up.
meaning_reversed: Emotional immaturity, wearing your heart on your sleeve in risky situations, or a message not landing well.

name: Knight of Cups
meaning_upright: Romantic, idealistic, and following the heart. Riding in with charm and emotional intensity.
meaning_reversed: Moody, unrealistic, or someone whose charm is not backed up by genuine follow-through.

name: Queen of Cups
meaning_upright: Empathetic, nurturing, intuitive. She holds space beautifully and leads from an emotionally wise place.
meaning_reversed: Over-giving, co-dependency, or losing yourself in others' emotions to the point of emotional exhaustion.

name: King of Cups
meaning_upright: Emotionally mature, compassionate, and steady. Leads with empathy and handles hard situations with grace.
meaning_reversed: Emotional volatility masked by a calm exterior, manipulation, or emotional suppression and withdrawal.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: A breakthrough — clear thinking, raw truth, and mental clarity cutting through the noise. Say it out loud.
meaning_reversed: Confusion, bad information, or a truth that is hard to receive or deliver right now.

name: 2 of Swords
meaning_upright: Stuck at a crossroads, avoiding a decision, or trying to stay neutral when you really need to choose.
meaning_reversed: Indecision breaking open, facing what you were avoiding, or information emerging to help you decide.

name: 3 of Swords
meaning_upright: Heartbreak, grief, or a painful truth hitting hard. Let yourself feel it — healing starts by facing it.
meaning_reversed: Moving through grief, releasing pain, or a wound that is finally beginning to heal.

name: 4 of Swords
meaning_upright: Rest is non-negotiable right now. Step back, restore your energy, and give your mind a break.
meaning_reversed: Burnout because you refuse to rest, restlessness, or returning to action before you are ready.

name: 5 of Swords
meaning_upright: A hollow win — someone loses and no one feels great about it. Not every battle is worth fighting.
meaning_reversed: Letting go of conflict, seeking reconciliation, or walking away from a power struggle for good.

name: 6 of Swords
meaning_upright: Moving away from turmoil toward calmer waters. Transition, recovery, and things slowly getting better.
meaning_reversed: Resistance to leaving a difficult situation, or being forced to stay when you are ready to move on.

name: 7 of Swords
meaning_upright: Someone is being sneaky or dishonest — maybe even you. Watch for hidden agendas and half-truths.
meaning_reversed: Coming clean, a deception being uncovered, or finally being fully honest with yourself or others.

name: 8 of Swords
meaning_upright: Feeling trapped by your own mind. The cage is mostly mental — you have more freedom than you think.
meaning_reversed: Breaking free from limiting beliefs, seeing your way out, or finally removing the mental blindfold.

name: 9 of Swords
meaning_upright: Anxiety, overthinking, and worst-case-scenario spiraling at 3am. Your mind is in overdrive — breathe.
meaning_reversed: Anxiety easing, getting support for mental health, or realizing the fears were worse than the reality.

name: 10 of Swords
meaning_upright: Rock bottom — a painful ending that is also the final blow. The sun is rising even if it does not feel like it.
meaning_reversed: Refusing to accept an ending, or starting to rise from a really rough rock-bottom moment.

name: Page of Swords
meaning_upright: Curious, sharp, and eager for information. Watch out for gossip — this energy can cut both ways.
meaning_reversed: Spreading rumors, acting before thinking, or using sharp words in a way that creates more damage than good.

name: Knight of Swords
meaning_upright: Fast-moving, direct, and decisive — charging toward a goal with intense focus and no time for detours.
meaning_reversed: Rushing in recklessly, aggression, or bulldozing over people in pursuit of what you want.

name: Queen of Swords
meaning_upright: Sharp, direct, and clear-minded. She tells it like it is and does not let emotions cloud smart judgment.
meaning_reversed: Cold, cutting, or using sharp intelligence to wound rather than clarify and protect.

name: King of Swords
meaning_upright: Intellectual authority, strategic thinking, and fair-minded leadership. Think before you speak and lead with truth.
meaning_reversed: Tyrant thinking, manipulating with words, or letting cold logic override much-needed compassion.

name: Ace of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A new financial opportunity, job offer, or practical seed worth planting. This one is real — take it.
meaning_reversed: A promising opportunity falling through, poor timing on financial decisions, or greed blocking growth.

name: 2 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Juggling priorities and keeping the balance. You are managing — but something may need to give soon.
meaning_reversed: Overwhelmed and dropping the ball, poor financial management, or taking on way more than you can handle.

name: 3 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Teamwork and skilled collaboration. Working with others toward a shared goal — and doing it well.
meaning_reversed: Poor teamwork, taking all the credit, or a project stalling because of lack of coordination.

name: 4 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Financial security being guarded carefully — savings, stability, but watch for hoarding energy.
meaning_reversed: Loosening a grip on finances or control, letting things flow more freely, or financial insecurity emerging.

name: 5 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Hard times — financial strain, feeling left out in the cold. Support exists if you are willing to ask for it.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from hardship, finding support after struggle, or regaining financial and material stability.

name: 6 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Generosity and fair exchange. Giving and receiving in balanced measure — check the power dynamic here.
meaning_reversed: Strings attached to generosity, power imbalances in giving, or charity with expectations attached.

name: 7 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Stepping back to assess your progress. You have been working hard — is the investment paying off?
meaning_reversed: Impatience with slow returns, doubt in long-term strategy, or feeling like the work is not worth it.

name: 8 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Dedicated skill-building and mastery. Do the work, hone the craft, and keep improving every single day.
meaning_reversed: Working without direction, perfectionism getting in the way, or burning out on repetitive, unrewarding tasks.

name: 9 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Financial independence, self-sufficiency, and luxury earned through your own hard work. Enjoy it.
meaning_reversed: Overworking for status, losing yourself in material success, or financial comfort hiding inner emptiness.

name: 10 of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Long-term security, family legacy, and generational wealth and stability. The full life, built together.
meaning_reversed: Family conflict over money or inheritance, instability in what seemed secure, or trading soul for status.

name: Page of Pentacles
meaning_upright: A motivated learner starting out on a practical path — studying, planning, and building foundations.
meaning_reversed: Procrastination, lacking follow-through on practical goals, or all planning with zero execution.

name: Knight of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Steady, reliable, and hardworking. Slow and methodical but gets results — the tortoise winning the race.
meaning_reversed: Stuck in routine, being overly cautious, or a stubborn refusal to adapt even when flexibility is needed.

name: Queen of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Grounded, generous, and practical. She builds comfort, nurtures her people, and manages resources brilliantly.
meaning_reversed: Work-life imbalance, neglecting home or self-care, or letting financial anxiety override abundance.

name: King of Pentacles
meaning_upright: Abundance, prosperity, security, and disciplined success. Built it from scratch and made it look easy.
meaning_reversed: Financially obsessed, stubbornly materialistic, or letting wealth define your worth and every decision.
